'''Benjamin Gonzalez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Austin tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with Death Star 2, according to Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-austin-texas-8-04-01d2782/ austin-texas-8-04-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-austin-texas-8-04-01d2782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
